headline: Fintech giant Revolut ditches Claude for open-weight model, slashing AI costs
body: Revolut replaced Anthropic's Claude with an open-weight GLM model for AI-assisted coding, reducing expenses by 90 percent. This shift signals a critical inflection point for healthcare organizations evaluating AI vendor lock-in versus cost efficiency in clinical automation. Healthcare systems face identical tradeoffs when selecting between proprietary models like Claude and open alternatives for EHR integration, documentation automation, and clinical decision support. The move demonstrates that cost pressure now drives vendor selection even for mission-critical applications, forcing healthcare AI consultants to reassess total cost of ownership models. Expect similar migrations in healthcare IT as budget constraints tighten and open-weight alternatives mature for regulated workflows.
